headlines.title: EU to impose €2 fee on all packages entering the bloc as of 1 November
headlines.summary: A €3 fee also came into force in July, leading to a 60% drop in small parcel imports over three months. The new rules aim to counter imports from Chinese platforms, whose low prices threaten European retailers.

headlines.summary: Ursula von der Leyen, António Costa and Mark Carney hammered out the contours of a new partnership during a whirlwind 48 hours in Montreal. Here's everything you need to know.

headlines.summary: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

headlines.title: Islamic states prosecutors call for global enforcement coalition
headlines.summary: Law enforcement heads from 46 Islamic states gather in Baku to tackle cross-border financial crime, artificial intelligence and international asset recovery.

headlines.title: India increases growth forecast for fiscal year
headlines.summary: India s Ministry of Finance has increased its growth forecasts for the current fiscal year. But it also warned about inflation, particularly for fuel and energy, amid continued instability in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Tusk-Nawrocki battle escalates as chief judge is ousted from Poland’s top court
headlines.summary: A bid to remove the court’s nationalist-linked leadership sparked accusations of a coup and clashes between protesters and police in Warsaw.

headlines.summary: Cyber correspondent Joe Tidy explains more about what is suspected to be the biggest hack in history.

headlines.title: AstraZeneca profit jumps 23% on cancer drugs as it unveils major savings plan
headlines.summary: AstraZeneca's net profit jumped 23% in the third quarter on booming sales of its cancer drugs, as the British drugmaker unveiled a programme to save $1.5 billion (€1.34bn) a year to invest back into developing new medicines.

headlines.title: Volkswagen logs Q3 operating loss of €5.86 billion on Porsche writedown
headlines.summary: The Volkswagen Group has filed its worst quarterly performance since the height of the Dieselgate scandal in 2015. Share prices climbed in response, however, perhaps because the bad news was so well signposted.

headlines.title: China rejects report of spy plot targeting Nvidia's Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: Our regional cloud customers receive ordinary business information - not sensitive NVIDIA trade secrets - and zero information relevant to national security, a spokesperson for Nvidia told the AFP news agency on Friday.

headlines.summary: In shielding Europe s carmakers from Chinese rivals, the EU risks hurting close partners from Turkey and Morocco to Japan and South Korea. Billions in trade and hundreds of thousands of European jobs are at stake.

headlines.summary: The suspect was arrested while taking pictures at an unguarded railway crossing.

trend_headline: EU의 대중국 관세 장벽과 자동차·소매 섹터 충격
summary: EU가 중국산 저가 소포에 대한 추가 수수료 부과와 자동차 보호무역주의를 강화하는 가운데, 폭스바겐은 중국산 공세와 포르쉐 감손으로 58.6억 유로의 사상 최대 적자를 기록했습니다. 한편, 지정학적 리스크에 따른 유가 급등으로 BP의 순이익이 급증하며 에너지 섹터가 강세를 보였습니다.
key_points: EU, 11월 1일부터 중국산 저가 소포에 2유로 추가 수수료 부과 등 역내 소매업 보호 조치 강화
폭스바겐(VW), 중국 경쟁 심화 및 포르쉐 감손으로 Q3 58.6억 유로(약 8.8조 원) 영업 적자 기록
